# The Assumptions Reference

<DoxygenPage version="1.13.2">

Assumptions are conditions that must be satisfied for the test to proceed. <Link to="#details">More...</Link>

## Description {#details}

If an assumption fails, the test cannot continue and is terminated immediately.

<SectionDefinition>
